# 9A obligation cases

These fixed records are merged into `tests/fixtures/plan/plan.json` by the
public CLI test. They cover a valid feature plan with two obligations for one
requirement, a performance objective paired with an unchanged text check, and a
research result with explicit limitations. The latter two are intentionally
structurally valid but require semantic review; structural reachability is not
treated as evidence that the criterion captures the objective.

The existing fixture repository and policy remain the execution boundary. The
records are input fixtures, not reports or semantic judgments.
